builder.objective: V2-01 REPAIR — Fix 3 mustFix findings. Preserve the existing WIP baseline (commit 9415dc6). Fix only the following, do not expand scope: (1) Wire trial expiry into entitlement resolution: getEntitlement must check trialEndsAt and return Free when expired, without destroying data. (2) Implement Options personal and household screens with real navigation. Options household visible only to owner/payer. (3) Fix getAccountEntitlement to consult AccountRepository.ownedFreeHouseholdId instead of global entitlements map scan.

repairFindings.problem: getEntitlement returns plan:'trial' indefinitely without checking trialEndsAt
repairFindings.requiredFix: Wire trialEndsAt check into getEntitlement. When trialEndsAt < now, return entitlement with plan:'free' and Premium capabilities disabled. No data destruction.
repairFindings.verification: Deterministic test: startTrial, simulate trialEndsAt in past, assert getEntitlement returns plan:'free' with weightingEnabled/todoPlanningEnabled/historyArchiveAccess/scoreArchiveAccess false, no data deleted.

repairFindings.problem: Options personal and household screens are placeholders onPress={() => {}}
repairFindings.requiredFix: Implement Options personal (profile, notifications, privacy, legal, preferences) and Options household (subscription, administration, members, permissions) with real routes and screens. Options household visible only to owner/payer.
repairFindings.verification: Navigation from home screen to both Options screens works. Options household visible only when user is owner/payer. Tests cover access and content.

repairFindings.problem: getAccountEntitlement demo-free scans global entitlements map instead of AccountRepository
repairFindings.requiredFix: Resolve getAccountEntitlement via AccountRepository.ownedFreeHouseholdId, consistent with createHousehold.
repairFindings.verification: Test: user with ownedFreeHouseholdId set → canCreateFreeHousehold=false; user without → true, independent of other households' entitlements.

acceptance: Trial expiry wired: getEntitlement returns Free after trialEndsAt, deterministic test passes
Options household visible only to owner/payer
getAccountEntitlement resolves via AccountRepository, consistent with createHousehold
npm run check vert, 120+ tests green
No regressions in V2-00 or existing V2-01 evidence
